name: Bind
description: Prevents creatures from moving for 12 seconds, or players for 6 seconds.
effect: Holds a creature in place for 12 seconds (players 6 s). A normal GCD cast.

name: Snare
description: Prevents creatures from moving for 18 seconds, or players for 9 seconds.
effect: Holds a creature in place for 18 seconds (players 9 s). A normal GCD cast.

name: Vulnerability
description: Increases the target's damage received by 10% for 1 minute.
effect: Target takes 10% more damage for 1 minute (the same debuff as a vulnerability bomb). A normal GCD cast, no magic weapon needed.

name: Enfeeble
description: Reduces the target's damage dealt by 10% for 1 minute.
effect: Target deals 10% less damage for 1 minute. A normal GCD cast.

name: Entangle
description: Prevents creatures from moving for 24 seconds, or players for 12 seconds.
effect: Holds a creature in place for 24 seconds (players 12 s). A normal GCD cast.

name: Stagger
description: Reduces the target's chance to hit by 10% for 1 minute.
effect: Target's chance to hit −10% for 1 minute. A normal GCD cast.

name: Air Surge
description:
A very powerful air spell.
Damage scales up to level 100.
effect: Auto-cast air spell (the strongest standard air attack).

name: Water Surge
description:
A very powerful water spell.
Damage scales up to level 100.
effect: Auto-cast water spell.

name: Earth Surge
description:
A very powerful earth spell.
Damage scales up to level 100.
effect: Auto-cast earth spell.

name: Fire Surge
description:
A very powerful fire spell.
Damage scales up to level 99.
effect: Auto-cast fire spell (the strongest standard attack spell).

name: Penance
description:
Restore prayer points from damage taken.
- Applies Penance to self.
- 12m duration.

Can be cast during the global cooldown.
Aspect of sustain: You may only have one aspect active at once.

Penance
- 5% of damage taken is restored as Prayer Points, up to 100 per hit.
effect: For 12 minutes 5% of the damage you take is restored as prayer points (up to 100 per hit).

name: Vampyrism
description:
Drain life from your foes to heal yourself.
- Applies Vampyrism to self
- 12m duration.

Can be cast during the global cooldown.
Aspect of Sustain: You may only have one aspect active at once.

Vampyrism
- Heals you for 5% of damage dealt, up to 50 Life Points per hit.
effect: For 12 minutes heal 5% of the damage you deal (up to 50 life points per hit).

name: Smoke Cloud
description:
Disorient the target with a veil of smoke, leaving them vulnerable.
- Increases the critical strike damage by 15%.
- 2m duration.
- 40% effective for non-magic attacks.
effect: Target debuff for 2 minutes: critical strike damage against it +15% (+6% for non-magic attacks). A normal GCD cast, no magic weapon needed.

name: Intercept
description: Place a ward on an ally for 10 seconds, you will take all damage they would receive with a 5% reduction in damage.
effect: Ward on an ally for 10 seconds: you take the damage they would receive, reduced by 5%.

name: Animate Dead
description:
Replace life with shadows to create a shield from the fallen.
For each piece of magic tank equipment worn:
- Gain 10% of its armour value as flat damage reduction.
- Gain 25% of your defence level as flat damage reduction.
- 12m duration.
- Only core damage types can be reduced by this effect.
- Damage cannot be reduced by more than 60% due to this effect.
- Reduced effectiveness in PvP.

Aspect of Evasion: You may only have one aspect active at once.
effect: Flat damage reduction from worn magic tank armour (10% of its armour value per piece + 25% of your Defence level, max 60%) for 12 minutes. Ignores the global cooldown and does not interrupt channels.

name: Shield Dome
description: Create an energy shield for 15 seconds that will protect all players within it, reducing damage by up to 50%. Each different shield following this will have diminishing returns that reset after 2 minutes.
effect: Energy shield for 15 seconds reducing damage to every player inside by up to 50% (diminishing on repeated casts).

name: Smoke Barrage
description:
A very powerful area air spell, which also reduces the target's chance to hit by 5% for 10 seconds.
Damage scales up to level 100.
effect: Auto-cast air spell: hits a 3x3 area and lowers the targets' accuracy by 5% for 10 s.

name: Shadow Barrage
description:
A very powerful area earth spell, which also reduces the target's damage dealt by 5% for 10 seconds.
Damage scales up to level 100.
effect: Auto-cast earth spell: hits a 3x3 area and lowers the targets' damage by 5% for 10 s.

name: Blood Barrage
description:
A very powerful area fire spell, which also heals you for 5% of the damage dealt.
Damage scales up to level 100.
effect: Auto-cast fire spell: hits a 3x3 area and heals 5% of the damage dealt.

name: Ice Barrage
description:
A very powerful area water spell, which also prevents creatures and players from moving for 9.6 seconds.
Damage scales up to level 100.
effect: Auto-cast water spell: hits a 3x3 area and freezes creatures for up to 9.6 s.

name: Exsanguinate
description:
An extremely powerful fire spell. On ability cast, gain a stack of Blood Tithe (max 12) for 20s.
- Each stack of Blood Tithe increases basic ability base damage by 1%
Damage scales up to level 100.
effect: Auto-cast fire spell: every ability cast grants a Blood Tithe stack (max 12, 20 s), +1% basic ability damage per stack.

name: Incite Fear
description:
An extremely powerful water spell. On ability cast, gain a stack of Glacial Embrace (max 5) for 20s.
- Each stack of Glacial Embrace reduces the adrenaline cost of Tsunami by 12%
- At 5 stacks, your ability casts trigger Frost Surge (12s cooldown).
- Frost Surge deals (10-50%) ability damage to the primary target and up to 8 adjacent enemies in a 5x5 area around your target.
Damage scales up to level 100.
effect: Auto-cast water spell: every ability cast grants a Glacial Embrace stack (max 5, 20 s); at 5 stacks Frost Surge fires (12 s cooldown) and Tsunami costs 12% less per stack.

name: Cure Me
description: Cure yourself of poison.
effect: Cures poison.

name: Disruption Shield
description: The next hit you receive from another player or NPC is negated.
effect: Blocks the next hit you take (one hitsplat of melee, ranged, magic, necromancy or soft typeless damage). Off the global cooldown, 60 s cooldown; cannot be recast while it is still up. Takes priority over Vengeance and Resonance.

name: Heal Other
description: Consume 75% of your current life points to heal the targeted player.
effect: Consumes 75% of your current life points to heal the targeted player.

name: Vengeance Other
description: The next time the targeted player receives damage, 75% of the damage received is instead dealt to the attacker.
effect: Vengeance on the targeted player. Off the global cooldown; shares the 30 s Vengeance cooldown.

name: Vengeance
description: The next time you receive damage, 75% of the damage received is instead dealt to the attacker.
effect: The next hit you take deals 75% of its damage back to the attacker (cap 8,000, boosted by Vulnerability). You still take the full hit. Off the global cooldown; 30 s cooldown shared with Vengeance Other / Group.

name: Heal Group
description: Consume 75% of your current life points to heal all nearby players.
effect: Consumes 75% of your current life points to heal all nearby players.

name: Vengeance Group
description: The next time any nearby player receives damage, 75% of the damage received is instead dealt to the attacker.
effect: Vengeance on yourself and every player within 4 tiles (up to 50). Off the global cooldown; shares the 30 s Vengeance cooldown.

name: Spellbook Swap
description: Allows you to cast a single spell from the Standard or Ancient spellbooks.
effect: Cast a single spell from the Standard or Ancient spellbook (up to 2 minutes to use it). Off the global cooldown from the action bar.
